Dual (grammatical number).question: The _____ was Grammatical number in addition to singular and plural.
Dual (grammatical number).fact: Dual (abbreviated du) is a grammatical number that some languages use in addition to singular and plural. When a noun or pronoun appears in dual form, it is interpreted as referring to precisely two of the entities (objects or persons) identified by the noun or pronoun acting as a single unit or in unison.
